svg.text: MV0-C04 / HR-V0-ARM-ARCH-P0.6 - PRELIMINARY - CANDIDATE GEOMETRY ONLY - NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION OR ENERGIZATION
Finished envelope: 48.00 x 40.00 x 9.525 nominal; 6061-T651 plate from held OnlineMetals 1249 stock.
Frame pattern: 4 x diameter 2.70 at project X/Z (-11,+8), (+11,+8), (-12,-6), (+12,-6)
Structural/member pattern: 2 x diameter 5.50 with 11.30-11.40 countersink at X=0, Z=+/-10
All hole coordinates are basic to the part center; coordinate tolerance +/-0.05 mm.
Hole diameters, thickness, flatness, parallelism, edge break and FAI controls are in the CSV schedule.
The four H104 axes are exact cylindrical axes extracted from controlled FR12-H104K STEP; drawing dated Aug-31-17.
The selected subset avoids the two M5 countersinks nominally and is verified against the transformed H104 STEP.
Received-part fit, exact stack, installation torque, locking, tool access and proof remain required.
Supplier DFM and one separately authorized first article precede any use on an assembly.
DO NOT FABRICATE, ASSEMBLE, CONNECT, OR ENERGIZE FROM THIS DRAWING ALONE.
Units: mm | Projection: plate face X-Z | Date: 2026-08-07
